entries.title: Latest release
entries.summary: Show the newest GitHub release that is not a prerelease, with its link.
steps: Get Contents of URL: https://api.github.com/repos/OWNER/REPO/releases
Run JSON Filter with the filter below, output One item per result
If Filter Results has any value
Show Result: Filter Results
End If
valuesToChange: OWNER and REPO in the URL

entries.title: API response to a notification
entries.summary: Turn fields from an API response into one sentence and show it as a notification.
steps: Get Contents of URL: your weather API URL
Run JSON Filter with the filter below, output Raw text lines
If Filter Results has any value
Show Notification: Filter Results
End If
valuesToChange: The field names in the filter

entries.title: Array to spreadsheet
entries.summary: Turn a list of objects from an API into a CSV file in Files.
steps: Get Contents of URL: an API that returns a list of objects
JSON to CSV, Header Row on
If Table has any value
Save File: Table, to a folder you pick
End If
valuesToChange: Columns, if you only want some keys
entries.filterNote: The JSON to CSV action makes the table without a filter. This filter builds the same CSV, so you can try it in the Playground.

entries.title: Folder of JSON files
entries.summary: Run one filter over every JSON file in a folder and combine the results.
steps: Get Contents of Folder: the folder with your JSON files
Repeat with Each item in Contents of Folder
Run JSON Filter on Repeat Item with the filter below, output Raw text lines
End Repeat
Combine Repeat Results with New Lines
If Combined Text has any value
Show Result: Combined Text
